# aether_organization (Data Source)

The provider's organization (the one `organization_id` names, or the one the API token belongs to). `billing_email` and `vat_id` are null when the organization has never set them.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `billing_email` (String) Billing contact address; null when unset.
- `created_at` (String) Creation time (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Organization UUID.
- `name` (String) Display name.
- `plan` (String) Organization plan.
- `slug` (String) URL-safe slug (also names the organization's registry project).
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time (RFC 3339).
- `vat_id` (String) VAT identifier; null when unset.
